title: Permanent lower bound for valid arithmetic circuits with division

circuit_model.validity: at every division gate, the divisor is a nonzero rational function in C(x_11,...,x_nn)
circuit_model.cost: nonscalar multiplication/division complexity; additions, subtractions, and scalar operations are free

claim: For every integer n >= 65536, every valid arithmetic circuit over C computing per_n has nonscalar multiplication/division complexity s >= (n^2/144) * (log2(log2(n)) - 3). Consequently every ordinary valid arithmetic circuit computing per_n has at least this many arithmetic gates.
